notes_sections.heading: Pipeline matches — not rescored/refiled
items: Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer — JFrog (Remote, Canada — real 🇨🇦 flag tag shown directly in results): already Applied in applications.md (2026-08-31, score 8, via Indeed).
Senior DevOps Engineer — Lemon.io (flag list of ~30 countries including 🇨🇦 Canada, Contract): already New in applications.md (2026-08-25, score 6, via RemoteOK).

notes_sections.heading: Search-term results
items: DevOps (23 results reviewed): the only two Canada-eligible target-family postings were the JFrog and Lemon.io pipeline matches above. Everything else was either region-restricted (UK, Ireland, Australia, various EU-only), a specific non-Canada US city despite the decorative "Anywhere in the World" tag (ZoomInfo, Fastly, CircleCI, Discord roles), or off-scope by role (sales, customer support, security engineering, account management).
Cloud (2 results): both Sales/Marketing category, not tech roles at all — this term's yield has degraded sharply from the "32 results" documented in the 2026-08-20 follow-up run in job_sources.md.
Platform (4 results): none Canada-relevant (Mexico, Sweden locations under the decorative tag; one data-analytics-adjacent management role, not target family).
Infrastructure (4 results): Pinterest Data Scientist roles (San Francisco, despite the decorative tag) — off-scope by role and likely off-scope by region.

Site Reliability Engineer and DevSecOps (bare default-rotation terms): both returned zero results outright, reconfirming the persistent multi-word-phrase gap documented across every prior run of this source.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: This is the first run where reports/data/wwr.json was actually written — prior WWR runs were tracked only in job_sources.md's narrative notes, not in the structured per-board data file this repo's other boards use. This file now exists going forward.

A genuine change from prior documented behavior: several results now show real per-country flag tags directly in the search-results list (not just the decorative "Anywhere in the World" tag), which made the eligibility gate faster to apply this run without needing to open every candidate individually.

The previously-recommended single-broad-term approach ("DevOps", "Cloud", "Platform", "Infrastructure") no longer yields much for this specific domain — "Cloud", "Platform", and "Infrastructure" returned almost nothing relevant this run, a notable degradation from the 2026-09-08 run's documented results. "DevOps" alone remains the only consistently useful term.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
